name: Nullharbor
notes: Flight menu Graphics copy is short and player-facing: Full / Balanced / Performance. One generic sentence that the Android app can use a high-refresh display when the phone offers one. No Fold, Gabe, Chrome internals, API names, Game Booster, GitHub URLs, or white-flash history in that row.
Install app row is hidden when NullharborAndroid / FarboundAndroid is present (native APK). Pages PWA still shows Install app where supported.

Audio pops: looped ambience buffers fade at the wrap and drop DC; UI/fold one-shots attack from zero; Sound off uses muteAll; window blur no longer hard-cuts audio (Fold/WebView focus storms). APK onPause sends nullharbor-pause, ramps, then pauses the WebView; onResume zeros then resumes the context. Loops stay single-instance.
versionName 2.16.8 · Android versionCode 10. Do not tag /releases/latest until this PR is merged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.8. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
